The '''Karflo Corporation Facility''' was a [[pressure]] located in [[Graith]] that was the headquarters for [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation's]] operations on the planet. Smaller than the [[TaggeCo Corporate Facility]], it supported five hundred personnel. Security was provided by Karflo's own security personnel.
